research_integrity: Analytical proof uses exact heat projectors and primal/dual optimal-transport certificates; rational checker samples finite parameter values and is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to unweighted crown graphs n>=5, symmetric unit jump rates and real Wasserstein-one/Lipschitz norms; not weighted or directed Markov generators. Curvature and semigroup estimates are known; the asserted new information is the exact full-time two-exponential norm, maximizing orbit and accelerating rate. Priority remains qualified. No independent review.
title: Exact all-time Wasserstein contraction and curvature acceleration on crown graphs
